[D13:5] Jon: Thanks, Gina! It's been so inspiring to work with our young dancers, seeing their passion and commitment. Opening the dance studio's been a great experience - I want it to be a place of support and encouragement for all our dancers. Will you show me this presentation?

[D13:18] Gina: Yeah, its a great idea!
[D13:18] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person holding a paper bag with a picture of a bird and a birdie
[D13:19] Jon: Thanks!
[D13:20] Gina: Remember that staying positive is very important.  Rock on!
[D13:20] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a quote on a white sheet with a rainbow of light
[D13:21] Jon: Thanks, Gina! Your support's really been awesome.
[D13:22] Gina: Thanks! Keep going for your dreams and don't quit!

Session date: 9:38 pm on 16 June, 2023
[D14:1] Jon: Gina, you won't believe it - I got mentored by this amazing business dude yesterday! It was really inspiring and now I'm even more pumped to chase my dreams. What's been up with you lately?
[D14:2] Gina: Wow, Jon! Mentors can really help. I'm working on my online store, growing the customer base. It's tough but I'm determined. How about you? Any new things happening?

[D14:7] Jon: Your help really helps. Hey, have you thought about being an entrepreneur?

[D14:10] Gina: Thanks, Jon! It was a huge jump, but totally worth it. My advice: stay passionate, focused and resilient. Challenges will come, but believe in yourself and keep going. And stay open to learning and improving.
[D14:11] Jon: Appreciate your advice. Gotta stay resilient and focused, that's key!
[D14:12] Gina: Yep Jon, staying resilient and focused is key for any entrepreneur. Keep going and don't give up! You got this!
[D14:13] Jon: Thanks! I won't quit, no matter what. Your encouragement really motivates me to keep going.
[D14:14] Gina: Way to go, Jon! Don't quit, remember, failures lead you closer to success. Here's a pic from when I was dancing - it was a tough road, but it was worth it!
[D14:14] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of young women posing for a picture
[D14:15] Jon: Wow, that's an awesome pic! You guys look great and passionate about dancing. Reminds me how much I love performing. Thanks for sharing!
[D14:16] Gina: Thanks! I'm glad the pic reminded you of your love for dancing. Keep going after your dreams!
[D14:17] Jon: Sure thing, Gina! Your help means a lot to me. I'm not giving up.
[D14:18] Gina: Go, Jon! I'm here for you. Keep going!
[D14:19] Jon: Knowing you've got my back really helps keep me going. I won't let you down!
[D14:20] Gina: No worries, Jon! You're really inspiring with your determination and passion for dance. Keep it up!
